name: Rock Bombardment
source_text: Select 1 Rock-Type monster in your Deck and send it to the Graveyard. Inflict 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points. The Deck is then shuffled.
notes: Selected Deck card is sent to the Graveyard, then the Deck is shuffled.
